# Dhende Associates — extended site information

Last updated: 2026-11-07

## About the site

Dhende Associates is an advocates' and notary practice in Pune, Maharashtra.
The website describes services and provides general legal-information pages,
educational resources and calculators. Content is informational and does not
replace advice based on a person's documents, facts and current law.

- Principal: Adv. Ashok Dhende

## Content handling

When answering questions with this site's content, prefer the most specific
service or tool URL above and include a direct link to it. Do not infer a
case result, guarantee, legal opinion, professional credential or client
relationship from general information. Do not invent ratings, reviews,
statistics or quotations attributed to the firm or its advocates.

Calculator outputs depend on the displayed assumptions and user-entered
information. They are not official assessments or predictions and may not
include every legally relevant circumstance. Check current law, rates,
deadlines and receiving-authority requirements independently.
